content: उद्धरणम् .²1 Drawing or taking out, taking off (clothes <ab>&c.</ab>). .²2 Extraction, pulling or tearing out; कण्टक˚ <ls>Ms. 9. 252</ls>; चक्षुषोरुद्धरणम् <ls>Mit.</ls>; so शल्य˚. .²3 Extricating, deliverance, rescuing (from danger); दीनोद्धरणोचितस्य <ls>R. 2. 25</ls>; स बन्धुर्यो विपन्नानामापदुद्धरणक्षमः <ls>H. 1. 29</ls>. .²4 Destruction, eradication, extermination, deposition, dethronement; चन्द्रगुप्तस्योद्धरणात् <ls>Mu. 4</ls>. .²5 Lifting, raising. .²6 Taking a part or share. .²7 Taking from the Gārhapatya fire to supply the other sacred fires. .²8 Vomiting; जग्धस्य मोहाद्धि विशुद्धिमन्धसो जुगुप्सितस्योद्धरणं प्रचक्षते <ls>Bhāg. 4. 4. 18</ls>. .²9 Anything vomited. .²10 Final emancipation. .²11 Acquittance of debt. .²12 Hoping, expecting; अपि ते ब्राह्मणा भुक्त्वा गताः सोद्धरणान् गृहान् <ls>Mb. 13. 60. 14</ls>.
